title: iTestAgent Promotion Batch Manifest
description: Self-describing, non-self-referential batch manifest for the iTestAgent promotion migration (G6 gate).

manifestVersion.description: Schema version of this manifest format.

baseCommit.description: Full SHA-256 of the base commit the batch was built on (the previous rollback tag commit).

stagedTreeHash.description: git write-tree of the staged payload tree, EXCLUDING this manifest file itself (avoids self-reference).

baselineMode.description: RED mode captured for the batch. B26 must be 'characterization'; B38/B41/B42 must be 'verification-missing'; all others 'red'.

baselineDigest.description: SHA-256 of the RED (or characterization/verification-missing) test output that defined the baseline contract.

greenCommand.description: Exact test command that passed in the GREEN phase (from the batch allowlist).

greenExit.description: Exit code of the GREEN test command; must be 0.

gateCommands.description: Record of gate executions with their exit codes.

lockInvariant.description: Present ONLY for B05/B37: {beforeSha256, afterSha256, equal:true} proving an export-map-only change left bun.lock byte-identical.

payloadFiles.description: Repo-relative path -> {sha256, bytes} for every payload file in this batch (excluding this manifest).

rollbackTag.description: Annotated rollback tag for this batch, per scripts/expected-batch-tag.ts.
